newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - Feb 12.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Palace on Tuesday urged the deletion of a provision in the Constitution which empowers the Supreme Court to review the government's economic policies. (JOURNAL/CHRONICLE)
- The Supreme Court has ordered Executive Secretary Ruben Torres and four others to justify within ten days the government's oil deregulation policy. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- President Ramos is against an extension of his term and that of other elected public officials and will campaign against it if the proposal is approved by the Congress. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
- The Philippine Monetary Board has approved the issuance of $750 million to $1.0 billion worth of bonds in the international capital markets. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- Stockholders of flag carrier Philippine Airlines on Monday approved a doubling in the firm's capitalisation to 20 billion pesos and elected two new members to the airline's 15-man board. (ALL NEWSPAPERS))

- In a bid to improve monitoring of funds in the financial system, the Central Bank plans to introduce a new monetary aggregate called M4, which would comprise of domestic liquidity plus foreign currency deposits of residents. (TODAY/INQUIRER)
